newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Merrill Lynch lends for Yorkshire bid.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Merrill Lynch lends for Yorkshire bid.

text.p: LONDON, Feb 24 (LPC) - Merrill Lynch is providing 1.2 billion stg in loans to back the 1.5 billion stg agreed offer for Yorkshire Electricity by US public utility companies American Electric Power and Public Service Co of Colorado, according to a source close to the deal.
Merrill is to be arranger and syndication agent for the credit, which is expected to be syndicated in both the United States and Europe.
The loan has a five year final maturity.

Yorkshire Holdings, which is equally owned by AEP and Public Service Colorado, will be used as a vehicle to acquire Yorkshire Electricity and will initially have a 75 percent debt and 25 percent equity structure, according to a banker. After the acquisition the company should retain an investment grade rating, the banker said.
Merrill Lynch is also merger and acquisition advisor for the bidders.
